g.title: Dracomancer
g.text: 矢印は include または実行。破線は条件付き。
■ その他の実行ファイル

a.xlink:title: include if=$(eval arg('selected') in ['hardware', 'preview'] and arg('connect_fc'))
include if=$(eval arg('start_control') and arg('selected') != 'preview') if=$(arg enable_haptics)
include if=$(eval (arg('start_control') or arg('enable_joint_angle_control')) and arg('selected') != 'preview')
$(arg robot_ns)_volume_radius_monitor if=$(arg enable_volume_radius_monitor) | teleop_fc_min_lowpass --filter if=$(arg enable_fc_min_lowpass)
